user.title: LiveKid
user.description: Paste the Bearer token from app.livekid.com (DevTools → Network → any pl.api.api-livekid-prod.com request → Request Headers → authorization). You can paste the whole header block; the token is extracted automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: LiveKid token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: LiveKid no longer accepts the saved token. Paste a fresh one.

error.no_token: No JWT found in the pasted text.
error.no_kid: This token is not a parent token (no child attached).

abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different account or child.
